plan.why: Python 3.12 chosen: dependencies support 3.12; mediapipe caps the upper bound (supports 3.9–3.12).

steps.name: uv init
steps.why: the project has no pyproject.toml; create a bare one pinned to Python 3.12 so `uv add` has a manifest to record dependencies in

steps.name: uv python install 3.12
steps.why: make CPython 3.12 available (uv downloads it into its own Python store if missing)

steps.name: uv venv
steps.why: create the project environment on Python 3.12, replacing any existing one

steps.name: uv add -r requirements.txt
steps.why: move requirements.txt's dependencies into pyproject.toml and install them
